Daylight — Align new-document expiry with the document header

Audit of the New > Documents create drawer: header expiry set, clear, dismiss, unsaved prompt, create, Details tab on Documents vs Passwords journey against 7 acceptance criteria and 4 scope statements read from the ticket. 1 of 6 rulebook checks were exercised; 3 defect(s) and 11 observation(s) were recorded.

Ticket as filed

Expand ticket text

Creating a document still exposes expiry through the legacy Details tab, while existing documents use the header expiry picker.

Scope. reuse DocumentExpiry in the create drawer header and remove the redundant expiry field. Hide Details for documents with no remaining fields; retain it when additional fields exist. Other asset types keep their current layout. Acceptance: * New documents expose Set expiry in the header. * Setting or clearing expiry uses the existing form state, save payload and unsaved-change protection. * Opening the picker does not submit the form.

Validation claimed in the ticket

21 focused Chromium browser tests pass across AssetCreateForm and DocumentExpiry; TypeScript and focused ESLint pass. Live application/UAT smoke remains outstanding. Frontend-only surgical fix; local runtime overrides excluded.

UX-LEX3475-01 Severity: S2 (Major) Pillar: Clarity & trust In scope
−10 pts Deduction

Expiry day shifts one day earlier for users west of UTC after save

Observed Defect & Evidence
EXPECTED
The day picked in the header (Friday, November 20, 2026) is the day shown after save, for every user, and the same day appears in the list Expires On column (DOC-08).
ACTUAL
The same saved record reads 'Expires November 20, 2026' in a UTC browser and 'Expires November 19, 2026' in America/Los_Angeles. The create payload carried expires_on 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z (201).
Evidence
  • explore/ux/lex3475-tz-la-probe-expiry-label.png (LA view, captured 17:43Z during exploration)
  • explore/ux/lex3475-utc-probe-expiry-label.png (UTC view, captured 17:44Z during exploration)
  • FEATURE.md, Create request payload: expires_on 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z, asset 01a19d24-4bdf-76a4-bf06-be478590bd8a
  • QA_TRACEABILITY.md section 5: expiry is stored as local midnight converted to UTC
Evidence Screenshot explore/ux/lex3475-tz-la-probe-expiry-label.png
explore/ux/lex3475-tz-la-probe-expiry-label.png Click to enlarge ⤢
Recommended Resolution
What to change
Keep expiry as a calendar date. Show the picked day without passing it through the viewer's time zone, or format it in the zone it was stored in. Decide the expiry semantics (date only, or an instant in the organization's zone) with the product owner before changing the payload. Acceptance: the same record shows the picked day in UTC, America/Los_Angeles and Asia/Kolkata, and the list shows the same day.
Developer
Find where the header label formats expires_on. Format the date part of the stored value with timeZone 'UTC', or send and read a date-only string. Backend change only if it stores a timestamp for this field. Not verified in this run: the actual code path.
Design
The user chose a day, so the product must show that day. Fluent date controls work on date values, not instants, so the same rule applies here.
shadcn/ui Implementation
No component change. Keep the existing Calendar-based picker in DocumentExpiry and fix the value mapping and label formatting. Not verified in this run/reference.
Fluent Design Alignment
Fluent DatePicker and Calendar take a date value (skill reference fluent-ui-design-system section 7, Dates row). Not re-verified in Fluent docs this run.
UX-LEX3475-02 Severity: S3 (Minor) Pattern: BP-73 Pillar: Design alignment & a11y Pre-existing
−3 pts Deduction

Organization pickers in the create drawer have no accessible name

Observed Defect & Evidence
EXPECTED
Each organization combobox is announced with a name such as 'Organization' (A11Y-05, WCAG 4.1.2).
ACTUAL
The accessibility snapshot lists two comboboxes that carry only their value text, 'Choose an organization': the header picker (ref f3e1562) and the picker under 'Where does this belong?' (ref f3e1614). Neither has a name.
Evidence
  • explore/ux-create-drawer-document-snapshot.yml, dialog region: two combobox entries with no name
  • explore/ux/ux-create-document-drawer-open.png
Evidence Screenshot explore/ux/ux-create-document-drawer-open.png
explore/ux/ux-create-document-drawer-open.png Click to enlarge ⤢
Recommended Resolution
What to change
Give each organization picker the accessible name 'Organization'. The value text 'Choose an organization' can stay.
Developer
Associate a label with the combobox trigger (id and htmlFor) or set aria-label='Organization' on the trigger. Acceptance: the snapshot shows combobox 'Organization' in both places.
Design
Every input and picker needs a label. Fluent's Field and Label pattern does this (skill reference section 5 and 8, component labelling).
shadcn/ui Implementation
Wrap the picker in shadcn Field with a FieldLabel 'Organization', or use Label with htmlFor pointing at the trigger id. Subcomponent names not verified in this run/reference; open the shadcn Field page before coding.
Fluent Design Alignment
Fluent Field and Label: each control keeps a visible or programmatic label. Not verified in the Fluent docs this run.
UX-LEX3475-03 Severity: S3 (Minor) Pillar: Design alignment & a11y In scope
−3 pts Deduction

Header expiry button's accessible name does not contain its visible text

Observed Defect & Evidence
EXPECTED
The accessible name includes the visible text ('Set expiry', or 'Expires November 20, 2026' after a pick), so voice-control users can say what they see.
ACTUAL
The button's accessible name is 'Document expiry'. Its visible text is 'Set expiry' (or 'Expires November 20, 2026' after a pick). Neither visible string appears in the name.
Evidence
  • explore/ux-create-drawer-document-snapshot.yml: button 'Document expiry' containing text 'Set expiry'
  • explore/ux/ux-expiry-set-r3.png (label after a pick)
Evidence Screenshot explore/ux/ux-create-document-drawer-open.png
explore/ux/ux-create-document-drawer-open.png Click to enlarge ⤢
Recommended Resolution
What to change
Start the accessible name with the visible text. Keep 'Set expiry' as the visible text, and add 'Document' as a screen-reader-only prefix, or drop the aria-label override.
Developer
Remove the aria-label that replaces the visible text, or make it start with the visible text. Move 'Document expiry' to aria-describedby if the context must stay. Acceptance: the snapshot name includes 'Set expiry', and after a pick it includes 'Expires November 20, 2026'.
Design
A button's visible text is its name. Extra context belongs in a description, not in a replacement name (Fluent button guidance, skill reference section 5).
shadcn/ui Implementation
shadcn Button (outline or ghost, sm) with the visible text as content and an sr-only span for the prefix (Tailwind class sr-only). Not verified in this run/reference.
Fluent Design Alignment
Fluent Button: the visible label is the accessible name, and icon-only buttons need a separate label (skill reference section 5). Not verified in the Fluent docs this run.
